changes.summary: Upload prompt no longer requires a dry run before publishing
Legacy reveal.js watermark reserve changed to zero; this styling was subsequently removed with reveal.js
Chapter lists capped at ten entries and grouped by topic
Show the generating model name on the first slide
Replace reveal.js and PDF assembly with direct animated Remotion rendering

notes: Output-submodule bumps are generated-content changes, not new renderer capabilities.
These changes constitute the 0.1.5 to 0.1.6 update; package.json and CHANGELOG.md now identify the target version as 0.1.6.
Automatic theme selection and advanced diagrams were discussed but not implemented.

Provider SRT contained one paragraph-long cue per scene. Short caption timings are estimated proportionally within each original cue; original provider files are preserved in video-work/provider-subtitles/.
